sections.heading: Photo Quality Tips
sections.body: We can work with whatever photos you have, but a few notes help:
items: Phone photos are fine — modern phones take great photos
Natural daylight makes finished work look its best
Take a 'before' shot every time, even if you're not sure you'll need it
A wide shot plus a tight detail shot tells the whole story
Crew shots with branded shirts and clean trucks read as professional

sections.heading: Perfect For
sections.intro: Trade work is visual work, and customers are deciding partly on whether the finished product looks like something they'd be proud to point at. The easiest fix most trade businesses can make is just showing the work honestly.

items.label: No photos at all
items.body: Your site has stock images of "hands holding wrenches" and zero shots of the actual work. Visitors can't tell whether your work is rough patch jobs or finish-grade craftsmanship — and they pick the business that shows.

items.label: Stuck with stock
items.body: You used a stock-photo toolbox image in 2020 and it's still there. It signals "I haven't updated this site in years" — even if everything else is fresh.

items.label: Beautiful work, hidden
items.body: You spent real time on a kitchen remodel or a clean panel job. The photos are on your phone and nowhere else. A flat before-and-after gallery would do more selling than any paragraph of copy.

items.label: Branded trucks, crew on the job
items.body: Your trucks are wrapped, your crew wears matching shirts, and customers see the brand on the road. A truck-and-crew section on the site reinforces that recognition the moment a homeowner lands on your homepage.

items.label: Multi-crew shop with multiple service lines
items.body: You want visitors to see each trade or each crew's work organized cleanly so a homeowner can match a service to a portfolio before they reach out.

faqs.question: Where do the photos come from?
faqs.answer: From you. Phone photos are great. Send a Dropbox / Google Drive folder, an AirDrop bundle, or just email them to us and we'll handle the organization.

faqs.question: Do I need a professional headshot?
faqs.answer: Not required, but it helps. A clean phone portrait against a neutral background works fine. If you want a professional one, we can recommend local photographers who do good owner / crew portraits at reasonable rates.

faqs.question: Will the gallery slow my site down?
faqs.answer: No. Every image is compressed and resized at build time, served via a global edge network, and lazy-loaded so off-screen photos don't load until needed. Galleries with 50+ photos still feel fast on mobile.

faqs.question: Do you write captions and alt text?
faqs.answer: Yes. We caption photos by category and write descriptive alt text for accessibility, SEO, and AI engines. You can edit any of it on review.

faqs.question: Can I add new photos after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. Email new photos anytime — we add them with proper captions and alt text. New-photo turnaround is same-week on Complete and Growth plans.
